crownPassive.name: Shaper of flesh
crownPassive.text: Your summoned cards arrive with +2 health and +1 Attack.

bond.name: Mourning in Gwynedd
bond.text: Your front-rank cards have +1 Guard for each of your Cymru heroes that has died.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Shape-shift
actions.text: An enemy front-rank card becomes a harmless animal; its Attack is 0 for the rest of the fight.

actions.name: Battle of the trees
actions.text: Summon a Tree Warrior (2 Health, 2 Attack) into an empty front-rank slot of yours. It attacks the card opposite.
